title: Decision tree depth detects nonconstancy
statement: Let $f:\\{0,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. Its minimum decision tree depth is at least $1$ if and only if there exist inputs $x$ and $y$ such that $f(x)\ne f(y)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a function from the Boolean cube to the sign set
